meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 把git任务拆成提交、变基、历史调查等模式处理:先读取仓库状态取证,再只执行你明确要求的操作(如原子提交、rebase/squash、blame/bisect),并给出带命令证据的结论。普通代码编辑不干预。
howto.when: 当你提出提交代码、改写提交历史(如rebase、squash),或询问某改动何时由谁引入等git历史问题时触发;一般性改代码不会触发。

say.text: 帮我把这两个改动拆成两个原子提交
say.note: 会先检查diff再按功能分组提交

say.text: 用git blame查一下这行最后一次是谁改的
帮我用autosquash把fixup整理进对应提交
say.note: 按fixup目标自动整理并执行rebase

howto.what_en: Classifies git requests into commit, rebase, history, or status modes; reads repository state for evidence, then only performs operations you explicitly asked for, such as atomic commits, rebase/squash, blame, bisect, and reports command-backed conclusions. It leaves ordinary code edits alone.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask to commit, rewrite history (rebase, squash), or investigate when/who/why a line or commit changed; it is skipped for ordinary code edits.

say_en.text: Split these two changes into two atomic commits.
say_en.note: It inspects the diff and groups by feature.

say_en.text: Use git blame to find the last author of this line.
say_en.note: It returns the commit hash, author, and time.

say_en.text: Autosquash my fixup into the matching commit.
say_en.note: It targets the fixup and runs an interactive rebase.
